kultivator.screen.help.gabung_sekte:
Besides founding your own hall you may become a disciple of an NPC sect. A sect enters your Directory once you visit its gate, hear of it in a tea house, meet a recruiter at a Sect Office or the Gate Day, read the capital's ranking board, or receive a letter of invitation.

Application: pick one of five doors (Gate Trial, Sect Ascension Token, Tournament Invitation, Servant Door, Guest Elder). Pass the requirement lines and you are a Candidate for 3 days; come to the gate on the Test Day.

Three stages: the Trial Stair (keep the Mountain Pressure down; crouch still to meditate), the style test of the sect's corak, then the Trial of the Heart in the hall. The verdict sets your first rank, then the Oath Ceremony and the elders choosing disciples.

As a member you earn personal Contribution Points (PK, the same unit as the hall's, never exchanged for spirit stones) from chores, missions and wars, and spend them at the Merit Pavilion or on promotions in the Rank Tree.

Leaving: take an honourable leave when every condition is met (a Letter of Blessing with a teacher bond of 50+); leaving without leave hurts relations; deserting during a war call brings the sect's hunters.
kultivator.screen.help.kelas_sekte.title: Sect Classes
kultivator.screen.help.kelas_sekte:
A sect's class follows its tier 1-9: Minor School (1-2, "Third-Class Sect"), Middle Sect (3-4), Great Sect (5-6, "First-Class Sect"), Grand Sect (7-8, "Holy Land") and Immortal Sect (9). The higher the class, the harder the entry (realm, spiritual root, Bone Age, standing, Infamy, crime record) and the more it offers: techniques up to TIAN, pills, cave dwellings, secret realm quotas and the protection of its name.

The class factor (kf 0.6 to 2.0) multiplies promotion costs, the weekly allowance and PK rewards. Classes rise and fall over time; a weakening sect shows as DECLINING in the Directory.
kultivator.screen.help.corak_sekte.title: Sect Styles
kultivator.screen.help.corak_sekte:
A sect's style comes from the first word of its name and sets its stage-two test and its uniform: Sword (Hundred Cuts), Buddha (Corridor of Bronze Men, no killing), Beast (subdue without killing), Formation (Stone Maze), Element (Five Qi Pillars), Alchemy (One Furnace), Body (Carry the Mountain), Blood (Blood Pool), Poison (Three Cups) and Shadow (Silent Trial).

Techniques whose Dao matches the sect's style cost 20 %% less at the Merit Pavilion, and some daily chores pay more PK to the matching style.
